title: General English for Adults — Levels Academy
description: Adult classes focused on speaking, listening and confidence. Morning & evening groups.
blocks: General English for Adults — Levels Academy

Our course is designed to build real, confident English through a balanced mix of structure and practice. You’ll study with a strong teaching team that includes Georgian, American, and British teachers, so you get both clear explanations and authentic language exposure. With focused work on reading, writing, grammar, and vocabulary—plus dedicated speaking and pronunciation training—you’ll improve accuracy and fluency step by step. Groups are formed based on your level (after a placement test) and kept small, so you get personal attention and steady progress.

Everything you need is included in the course fee: age-appropriate Cambridge University Press textbooks and access to the Cambridge platform, along with engaging resources like fun texts, listening tasks, videos, and interactive activities. Lessons are 2 hours long and available both online and at the Academy, giving you flexibility without losing quality. With maximum 6 students per group and lessons built for active participation, you’ll stay motivated, speak more, and see measurable improvement over the four-month program.
What will students learn in this course?
Comprehensive development of all language skills: reading, writing, grammar, vocabulary, and independent study skills.
Improved pronunciation, intonation, and communication abilities.
